name: Sensitive-output technical controls
description: Internal evidence checks for bounded model and read-tool output protection, with current-policy execution evidence and retained sample findings.
limitations: Draft internal technical policy, not a law, regulatory mapping, certification or legal compliance conclusion.
Pattern observations do not prove ownership, confidentiality or a violation; missed or unsupported sensitive content can remain.
Samples use the last 100 global audit records filtered to bound applications and model/tool operations, not a time window or complete history.
At least one inspected current-policy output is required; this does not validate detector accuracy or every application, category, model, tool or route.
Unknown or incomplete checks are evidence gaps, not proof that content was disclosed. Unchecked releases include legacy, disabled, out-of-scope and partial-category checks.
Only calls routed through GovWeave are observed. Standalone content evaluations and active assessment calls do not count as production execution evidence.

sources.title: GovWeave bounded sensitive-output configuration and metadata evidence policy (not a law or certification)

controls.title: Every bound application exists and is active
controls.remediation: Restore or replace inactive application bindings.

controls.title: Sensitive output uses blocking or redaction
controls.remediation: Select block or redact after validating the detector on representative application data.

controls.title: The enabled output policy covers every bound application
controls.remediation: Include every bound application in the enabled output policy scope.

controls.title: Credential, email and Mainland China mobile checks are all selected
controls.remediation: Select all three categories required by this internal policy.

controls.title: Durable audit writing and reservation capacity are available
controls.remediation: Restore durable audit writing and capacity before serving protected output.

controls.title: The bounded sample contains inspected output under the current policy revision
controls.remediation: Exercise the current policy with authorized model or tool calls; standalone text evaluations do not establish execution evidence.

controls.title: The bounded sample has no observed releases or releases without all three category checks
controls.remediation: Investigate observed releases and missing checks; restoring configuration does not erase historical evidence.

controls.title: The bounded sample has no unknown output assessments or recovered incomplete calls
controls.remediation: Investigate unsupported output, failed checks and recovered incomplete calls; withhold unverified output.
